description: Structure-based superposition of AlgJ onto AlgX and comparison of active-site electrostatics
code:
import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H',
 'ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W',
 'TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
def parse(txt,chain):
    out=[]
    for ln in txt.split("\n"):
        if ln.startswith(("ATOM","HETATM")) and ln[16] in (" ","A"):
            rn=ln[17:20].strip()
            if rn not in AA3 or ln[21]!=chain: continue
            out.append((ln[12:16].strip(),AA3[rn],int(ln[22:26]),
                        np.array([float(ln[30:38]),float(ln[38:46]),float(ln[46:54])])))
    return out
J=parse(requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/4O8V.pdb",timeout=90).text,'A')
X=parse(requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/4KNC.pdb",timeout=90).text,'A')

def ca(at): 
    d={}
    for n,r,num,xyz in at:
        if n=='CA': d[num]=(r,xyz)
    return d
caJ,caX=ca(J),ca(X)
def pick(at,num,name):
    for n,r,nu,x in at:
        if nu==num and n==name: return x

def kabsch(P,Q):
    Pc,Qc=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0)
    H=(P-Pc).T@(Q-Qc); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T)); D=np.diag([1,1,d])
    R=Vt.T@D@U.T
    return R,Qc-R@Pc

# anchor on triad + nucleophile-loop
anchJ=[pick(J,190,'CA'),pick(J,192,'CA'),pick(J,288,'CA'),pick(J,287,'CA'),pick(J,289,'CA'),pick(J,192,'CB'),pick(J,288,'CB')]
anchX=[pick(X,174,'CA'),pick(X,176,'CA'),pick(X,269,'CA'),pick(X,268,'CA'),pick(X,270,'CA'),pick(X,176,'CB'),pick(X,269,'CB')]
P=np.array(anchJ); Q=np.array(anchX)
R,t=kabsch(P,Q)
numJ=sorted(caJ); numX=sorted(caX)
CJ=np.array([caJ[n][1] for n in numJ]); CX=np.array([caX[n][1] for n in numX])
for it in range(12):
    CJt=(R@CJ.T).T+t
    D=np.linalg.norm(CJt[:,None,:]-CX[None,:,:],axis=2)
    pairs=[]
    used=set()
    for i in np.argsort(D.min(1)):
        j=int(np.argmin(D[i]))
        if D[i,j]<4.0 and j not in used:
            pairs.append((i,j)); used.add(j)
    if len(pairs)<10: break
    R,t=kabsch(CJ[[p[0] for p in pairs]], CX[[p[1] for p in pairs]])
CJt=(R@CJ.T).T+t
rmsd=np.sqrt(np.mean(np.sum((CJt[[p[0] for p in pairs]]-CX[[p[1] for p in pairs]])**2,axis=1)))
print(f"Structure-based superposition AlgJ(4O8V_A) -> AlgX(4KNC_A)")
print(f"  aligned CA pairs (<4 A): {len(pairs)}  of {len(numJ)} AlgJ / {len(numX)} AlgX residues")
print(f"  CA RMSD over aligned core: {rmsd:.2f} A")
seqid=sum(1 for i,j in pairs if caJ[numJ[i]][0]==caX[numX[j]][0])/len(pairs)*100
print(f"  structure-based sequence identity over core: {seqid:.1f} %")
# triad correspondence check
mp={numJ[i]:numX[j] for i,j in pairs}
print("  triad mapping AlgJ->AlgX:", {k:mp.get(k) for k in (190,192,288,287,289,290,292)})

# ---- active-site electrostatics / groove charge ----
CHG={'D':-1,'E':-1,'K':+1,'R':+1,'H':+0.1}
def pocket_charge(at, ser, radius):
    og=pick(at,ser,'OG')
    res={}
    for n,r,num,x in at:
        if np.linalg.norm(x-og)<radius: res[num]=r
    q=sum(CHG.get(r,0) for num,r in res.items())
    pos=sum(1 for r in res.values() if r in 'KR'); neg=sum(1 for r in res.values() if r in 'DE')
    arom=sum(1 for r in res.values() if r in 'WYF')
    return len(res),q,pos,neg,arom
print("\nResidues within radius of catalytic Ser OG (formal charge, Arg/Lys, Asp/Glu, aromatics)")
for radius in (10,12,15,18):
    nJ,qJ,pJ,nnJ,aJ=pocket_charge(J,288,radius)
    nX,qX,pX,nnX,aX=pocket_charge(X,269,radius)
    print(f"  r={radius:2d} A  AlgJ: n={nJ:3d} q={qJ:+5.1f} K/R={pJ:2d} D/E={nnJ:2d} arom={aJ:2d}   |   AlgX: n={nX:3d} q={qX:+5.1f} K/R={pX:2d} D/E={nnX:2d} arom={aX:2d}")

# figure
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11,4.2))
radii=[8,10,12,15,18,20]
qJ=[pocket_charge(J,288,r)[1] for r in radii]
qX=[pocket_charge(X,269,r)[1] for r in radii]
axes[0].plot(radii,qJ,'o-',label='AlgJ (4O8V, P. putida)',color='#C0504D')
axes[0].plot(radii,qX,'s-',label='AlgX (4KNC, P. aeruginosa)',color='#4F81BD')
axes[0].axhline(0,color='grey',lw=0.8)
axes[0].set_xlabel('radius around catalytic Ser OG (A)'); axes[0].set_ylabel('net formal charge of enclosed residues')
axes[0].set_title('Active-site electrostatic character'); axes[0].legend(fontsize=8)
nJ=[pocket_charge(J,288,r)[2] for r in radii]; dJ=[pocket_charge(J,288,r)[3] for r in radii]
nX=[pocket_charge(X,269,r)[2] for r in radii]; dX=[pocket_charge(X,269,r)[3] for r in radii]
w=0.35; xs=np.arange(len(radii))
axes[1].bar(xs-w/2,[a-b for a,b in zip(nJ,dJ)],w,label='AlgJ (K+R)-(D+E)',color='#C0504D')
axes[1].bar(xs+w/2,[a-b for a,b in zip(nX,dX)],w,label='AlgX (K+R)-(D+E)',color='#4F81BD')
axes[1].set_xticks(xs); axes[1].set_xticklabels(radii); axes[1].axhline(0,color='grey',lw=0.8)
axes[1].set_xlabel('radius around catalytic Ser OG (A)'); axes[1].set_ylabel('basic minus acidic residues')
axes[1].set_title('Charge composition of the active-site neighbourhood'); axes[1].legend(fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
